useful to extend to a broader population including elderly participants: Spatial assess ment provides the potential to act as an early stage diagnostic tool for Alzheimer's dementia (AD), because spatial disorientation is one of the earliest symptoms [24, 44-48]. Currently there is no standardized test for navigation deficits with AD patients; as diagnostics measures are still focused on episodic memory deficits; despite their low sensitivity and specificity for identifying at-risk individuals [26]. Sea Hero Quest wayfinding task having real-world ecologi cal validity holds future promise for controllable; sensitive; safe, low-cost; and easy to adminis ter digital cognitive assessment. ability

## Supporting information

SI Fig; Wayfinding virtual task. Maps of wayfinding Sea Hero Quest levels 1, 6, 11, 16 and 43. Starting position and facing direction are indicated by a blue arrow, ordered goals by red Participants must memorize the map, and then navigate towards the in the right order as quick as possible (PDF) pale flags. goals

S2 Fig. Wayfinding real-world task in London (UK). Maps of real-world wayfinding routes (top). Starting position and direction are indicated by a yellow arrow; ordered by red dots. Participants must memorize the map, and then walk towards the in the right order as as possible: Goals are materialized by remarkable doors (bottom). (PDF) facing goals goals quick

S3 Wayfinding real-world task in Paris (France) of real-world wayfinding routes (top) Starting position and direction are indicated by a green arrow; ordered by yellow dots. Participants must memorize the map, and then walk towards the in the right order as as possible: Goals are materialized by remarkable facade (bottom) (PDF) Maps facing goals goals quick

S4 Fig. Path integration task in the virtual and real-world environments. A-Maps of Sea Hero Quest integration levels 14, 34, 44, 54 and 74. B\_Itineraries of the integration task in Paris (France). Each color corresponds to a different itinerary. (PDF) path path

S5 Fig. Path integration gender effect. Gender differences for the integration task in the video game (right) and in the real world (left) in Paris. In the real world, integration per formance is the opposite of the average error angle. In the video game, integration mance is the average number of stars. Both measures have been standardized for comparison. Black dots represent individual data points. Error bars represent standard errors. (PDF) path path path perfor -
